newsitem.title: USA: Stone Energy has South Timbalier blowout.
newsitem.headline: Stone Energy has South Timbalier blowout.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp said Tuesday it experienced a natural gas blowout of its No. 3 Well at South Timbalier Block 8 Field during a routine workover procedure.

All personnel and equipment used in the operation were safely evacuated from the platform located in state coastal waters offshore Terrebonne Parish, La. Initially, the well flowed only dry natural gas around the wellhead, the company said. Subsequently the flow included a minimal amount of condensate.
Stone Energy said it activated its emergency response plan and a well control plan will be implemented by the company and well control specialists.
